run_grpc_client_tests: run the ClientTest unittest suite to verify gRPC client behavior across all RPC patterns
test_unary_unary_rpc: test successful unary-unary RPC calls using a fake gRPC channel and assert SATISFACTORY outcome
test_stream_stream_rpc: test bidirectional streaming RPC calls by sending multiple requests and responses through a fake channel
test_concurrent_stream_stream: test concurrent bidirectional streaming RPCs across multiple simultaneous RPCs on a single channel
test_cancelled_and_error_scenarios: test cancelled unary-unary RPCs and deadline exceeded stream-stream RPCs to verify error handling
